SURVEY LOKASI
RENCANA BANTUAN SUMUR BOR
POKTAN DI WILAYAH
KECAMATAN BALEN
KABUPATEN BOJONEGORO
Kegiatan survei lokasi calon penerima bantuan sumur bor dilaksanakan oleh Tim Supervisi Dinas Ketahanan Pangan dan Pertanian Kabupaten Bojonegoro di sejumlah kelompok tani yang berada di Kecamatan Balen. Kegiatan ini bertujuan untuk melakukan verifikasi dan penilaian langsung terhadap kondisi lapangan sebagai dasar penentuan kelayakan lokasi penerima bantuan sumur bor.
Dalam pelaksanaan survei, tim meninjau kondisi lahan pertanian, ketersediaan sumber air, luas areal yang akan dilayani, serta potensi pemanfaatan sumur bor untuk mendukung kegiatan budidaya tanaman, khususnya padi. Selain itu, tim juga berdialog dengan pengurus dan anggota kelompok tani guna menggali informasi mengenai kebutuhan air irigasi, kendala yang dihadapi pada musim kemarau, serta kesiapan kelompok dalam mengelola dan memelihara sarana yang akan diberikan.
Melalui kegiatan ini diharapkan bantuan sumur bor dapat disalurkan secara tepat sasaran kepada kelompok tani yang benar-benar membutuhkan, sehingga mampu meningkatkan ketersediaan air irigasi, mengurangi risiko gagal tanam akibat kekeringan, serta mendukung peningkatan produktivitas pertanian di Kecamatan Balen. Sinergi antara Dinas Ketahanan Pangan dan Pertanian Kabupaten Bojonegoro, penyuluh pertanian, dan kelompok tani diharapkan dapat memperkuat upaya mewujudkan ketahanan pangan dan kesejahteraan petani secara berkelanjutan.

Navigating growth, leadership, and innovation in polyurethanes, Robert (Bob) Tauchen, VP of Polyurethanes at the Coim Group, joins Victoria Meyer for an expert look at how the industry is adapting to shifting markets and new technologies. Bob explains Coim’s global strategy as a family-owned Italian company investing deeply in the US, first in New Jersey, and now expanding to Texas to address the evolving needs of North American customers. 

Victoria and Bob discuss the realities of growth expectations post-COVID, why long-term vision is essential in the chemical industry, and how relationships, trust, and reliability drive success in the US market. They also explore how leadership styles are changing with new generations, the stressors facing today’s teams, and why building context and motivation is more important than ever.  

Key topics this week include: 
Global Expansion: How Coim’s strategy balances investment, logistics, and customer proximity in the US 
Industry Recovery: The impact of COVID-era growth spikes and how to reset realistic performance goals 
US Market Dynamics: Why trust, reliability, and local presence matter more than price 
Leadership Today: Managing across generations, keeping teams engaged, and adapting to new expectations 
AI in Chemicals: Where AI brings value, why implementation is complex, and the need for thoughtful investment 

Killer Quote: “The short-term growth addiction that I see, people make bad decisions..... we got addicted to this COVID profit margin return to significant growth.” — Bob Tauchen

Menteri Pertanian Andi Amran Sulaiman menyatakan stok Cadangan Beras Pemerintah (CBP) telah melampaui 5 juta ton, yang disebut menjadi capaian tertinggi sepanjang sejarah Indonesia. Pernyataan itu sejalan dengan data pemerintah yang menunjukkan stok beras nasional terus meningkat sepanjang 2026, di tengah upaya memperkuat swasembada pangan dan mengurangi ketergantungan impor.

Dalam kesempatan yang sama, Amran juga menawarkan program hilirisasi pertanian senilai sekitar Rp9 triliun. Ia mengajak masyarakat memanfaatkan lahan untuk ditanami komoditas strategis melalui program pemerintah, sekaligus mendorong pengolahan hasil pertanian di dalam negeri agar memberi nilai tambah bagi petani dan perekonomian nasional.

포켓몬 어나더레드 2.0/3.0/4.0 all랜덤 너즐록챌린지 룰

------------크게 변경된 점------------
1. 야생 랜덤, 상대 트레이너 포켓몬 랜덤에서
이제 기술 관련, 포켓몬 타입 빼고 다 랜덤 (자세한건 밑에 --랜덤으로 된것-- 참고)

2. AI 개선의 개선
ㄴ 기존 AI가 이지라면 5단계로 이지/노말/하드/익스/헬 난이도로
분할
ㄴㄴ 기존 로직을 개선하여 상대가 대미지 계산식을 더 효율적으로 하게 만듦

3. 교체 룰에서 토너먼트 룰로 변경 ex) 아르코가 나온다 교체할까? 없어짐
ㄴ난이도 개 빡세짐

4. 상대 트레이너가 처음부터 최종진화체 포켓몬 꺼냄
ㄴ 난이도 개 빡세짐

5. 에이스 포켓몬 등록하면 HUD로 평소 게임화면에 종족값/특성/패시브 노출됨

6. 정보 추출로 랜덤값 바뀐거 html 파일로 저장됨

7. 야생 미진화체 포켓몬 안 나옴

------------랜덤으로 된것------------
1. 트레이너 (나) 랜덤
a. 야생 포켓몬 랜덤
b. 자력기 랜덤
c. 특성 랜덤
d. 패시브 랜덤
e. 종족값 n빵 +- 60% 랜덤
f. 1렙 진화 랜덤

2. 트레이너 (상대) 랜덤
a. 엔트리 포켓몬 랜덤
b. 기술 배치 랜덤 (이제 공격기 3개)
c. 특성 랜덤 (그 트라이에 고정됨)
d. 종족값 랜덤 (그 트라이에 고정됨)

땅바닥에 줍는 아이템 랜덤

------------하는법------------
1. 레쿠쟈갤러리 [추가패치] 어나더 레드 올인원 패치 (5/5) 다운
https://gall.dcinside.com/mgallery/board/view/?id=rayquaza&no=219004&search_head=70&page=1

2. 에투샤 팬카페 가입 (디스코드 주소)

3. 에투샤 디스코드 - 프로젝트 어나더레드 게시판 파일 최신 다운

순서 : 레겔에서 다운 받고 에투샤 디코에서 받은 패치
data 폴더에 넣으면 끝

많이 묻는 질문
스프라이트 : 구글링으로 검색 ex) 어나더레드 난천 스프라이드


원격컨트롤러 받고 (레드 집 2층)
a. 필수 켜기 들어갔다가 나오기
b. 어나레 저장(=리포트=세이브)
c. 정보 추출 (a버튼 2번 누르기)
d. 배틀 기믹 도구 받기
e. 메가진화 1회 제한 해제 껐다가 키기

시작

※추후에 저장하고 껐다가 키면 메가진화 1회 제한 해제만 껐다가
다시 키기

------------본격적인 룰 설명------------
------------☠️ 너즐록 기본 국룰------------
1. 각 지역에서 첫 번째, 두 번째로 만난 야생 포켓몬만 잡을 수 있다.
2. 기절한 포켓몬은 죽은 것으로 간주하여 놓아준다

------------⚔️ 필드 및 배틀 룰------------
1. 야생 배틀 금지 (피할 수 없는 경우 제외)
2. 체육관 관장에게 도전하기 전,
해당 지역의 모든 싱글 배틀 트레이너와 의무적으로 싸워야 한다 (에눈박놈 제외).
3. NPC에게 고정으로 받는 포켓몬은 놓아주고, 대신 야생에서 1마리를 포획한다
4. 파티 내 전설의 포켓몬은 최대 2마리까지 허용한다. (단, 초전설은 1마리만 가능)
5. 메가진화 1마리 제한 해제
6. 트레이너와 배틀 중 가방 금지
7. 상대 트레이너 최종진화체 포켓몬만 꺼낸다
8. 토너먼트 룰

------------🛠️ 엔트리 구성 (4+2 시스템)------------
1. 24마리의 스타팅 포켓몬 중 3마리를 선택하여 시작한다
2. 핵심 전력 (4마리): 성격 변경, 기술 배우기, 노력치 투자가 자유롭게 가능
3. 제물 (2마리): 어떤 형태든지 기술 배우기 금지, 자력기 사용만 가능
4. 노가다 금지: 알바, 뒤따라오는 포켓몬에게 아이템 받기 금지
5. 폼이 다른 포켓몬의 기술은 ex) 테오키스, 디아루가
사용 할 폼의 형태의 자력기만 배울 수 있다
원래 가지고 있던 기술은 사용할 수 있다
자시안, 그란돈, 제르네아스, 메가진화처럼
배틀에 나가야 폼체인지가 되는 포켓몬은
폼1의 기술을 배운다

------------⚙️ 그 외 시스템 및 인게임 패치 설정------------
1. 포켓몬 레벨업 필요 경험치량 '많음(Slow)'으로 통일
2. 배틀 후 자동 회복, 1회용 도구 유지, 딸피 BGM 끄기
3. 노력치 보이기
4. 포획률 및 박치기 확률 100%
5. 자동 낚시
6. 포켓몬 창에서 직접 기술 배우기 (처음부터 해금)
7. PC 및 공중날기 처음부터 해금

그 외에 더 많은데 기억이 안 남
여기까지가 룰 설명 끝

3.1 추가 패치

1. 적 트레이너 종족값 상한/하한 및 기술배치 조정은 data/txt/randomizer.txt에서 수정하시면 됩니다.

2. 포켓몬 기절하면 자동으로 놓아줍니다 (도구 회수)

3. 랜덤 아이템에 속임수주사위 및 8세대/9세대 일부 배틀 도구들 빠져있던거 추가

4. 관장 클리어시 패시브캡슐이라는 아이템을 받습니다. 
1회성 패시브 리롤 아이템이에요.

Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto welcomed Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to Jakarta's Merdeka Palace for the first visit to Indonesia by a Thai prime minister in 15 years.

The two leaders witnessed the signing of bilateral agreements and announced plans to establish a Joint Trade Commission aimed at boosting trade, investment and removing barriers to business. They also pledged closer cooperation in agriculture, logistics, supply chains, energy security, the digital economy and the use of Local Currency Transactions (LCT) in bilateral trade. Defence cooperation and joint military exercises were also highlighted during the talks.

Anutin is also scheduled to address the ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta, where he is expected to outline Thailand's regional priorities ahead of the country's 2028 ASEAN chairmanship.

The paradigm of warfare is shifting rapidly. While past wars focused on striking military bases or frontline positions, recently, "information hubs" and "logistics hubs"—key bottlenecks for civilian and national functions—have become the primary targets.

A new pattern of warfare involving physical strikes on data centers and large-scale logistics centers is clearly emerging on the fronts in the Middle East and Ukraine.

Recently, Iran and the United States have exchanged direct attacks on data centers in the Gulf region at least five times. This marks the first time this year that physical strikes involving missiles and drones—rather than cyber hacking—have been directed at data centers, making it a noteworthy shift.

According to a CNN report on the 3rd (local time), the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) designated 29 data centers belonging to Big Tech companies, including Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Palantir, as targets early in the conflict. Iran cited the fact that these companies cooperate with the U.S. military's cloud and military intelligence operations as the justification for the attacks.

Perkuat Wawasan Kebangsaan, Taruna Akmil Gelar Program Taruna Bakti di SRMA 7 Palembang

Sebanyak lima Taruna Akademi Militer (Akmil) Magelang yang dipimpin Sersan Taruna Tingkat II Abdul Ghony Zainudin dengan didampingi Perwira Pendamping Kapten Czi Reynald Ricardo Pontoh, S.Tr (Han), memberikan pendampingan serta pembelajaran kepada para siswa Sekolah Rakyat Menengah Atas (SRMA) 7 Palembang di Jalan Sosial, Kecamatan Sukarami. pada Senin (03/07/2026).

Kegiatan yang berlangsung selama satu minggu ini merupakan bagian dari program nasional Taruna Bakti Sekolah Rakyat yang berfokus pada pembinaan kedisiplinan, penanaman wawasan kebangsaan, pembentukan karakter, pemberian motivasi, hingga berbagi pengalaman pola hidup teratur kepada para generasi muda.

​Program edukatif ini dilaksanakan atas perintah Presiden RI Prabowo Subianto melalui Kementerian Sosial secara serentak di seluruh Indonesia, dengan melibatkan Taruna Akmil (TNI AD, AL, AU) dan Polri di 166 Sekolah Rakyat yang tersebar di 34 Provinsi.

Danyon Taruna Akmil, Letkol Inf Eko Wahyono, menjelaskan bahwa khusus di wilayah Sumatera Selatan terdapat 25 Taruna Akmil yang diterjunkan di lima Sekolah Rakyat. Melalui pendampingan langsung ini, para taruna sebagai calon pemimpin diajak untuk bersosialisasi dengan masyarakat serta memahami secara langsung dinamika di lapangan.

​Kehadiran para Taruna Akmil ini disambut hangat oleh Kepala SRMA 7 Palembang, Diana Nursanti, M.Pd., yang menilai program ini memberikan dampak positif dan motivasi luar biasa bagi para peserta didik.

Melalui interaksi langsung dan pembekalan nilai-nilai kebangsaan selama sepekan, diharapkan siswa-siswi SRMA 7 Palembang dapat meningkatkan kemandirian, kedisiplinan, serta rasa cinta tanah air, sehingga siap tumbuh menjadi generasi penerus bangsa yang unggul dan berkarakter.

The US-led 'Board of Peace' stated that the Israeli military will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas completely disarms. This official response came after a crucial meeting between Board Director Nickolay Mladenov and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in West Jerusalem. The meeting took place amidst sharp divisions within the Israeli government regarding the new peace agreement announced by US President Donald Trump last Thursday.

Representatives of the Board of Peace stated that the Israeli military will only withdraw beyond the current 'Yellow Line' after Hamas completely surrenders its light and heavy weaponry and dismantles its tunnels. They added that the primary objective is to end the rule of arms and restore civilian governance in Gaza. Donald Trump formed this committee last January to oversee the administrative duties in Gaza. However, Hamas maintains a firm stance that it will not step back unless Israel first complies with the terms of the agreement.

Mladenov demanded that Netanyahu immediately cease attacks on Gaza. Over 1,200 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli attacks since the ceasefire was declared in October 2025 alone. Just since the introduction of this new peace agreement, 36 people have lost their lives. More than 73,000 Palestinians have been killed so far in the war that began in October 2023. Mediator countries Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey have strongly condemned Israel's attacks on hospitals and civilians.

Upaya penyelamatan seekor hiu tutul (whale shark) yang terdampar di Pantai Sanghiangkalang, Batukaras, Kecamatan Cijulang, Kabupaten Pangandaran, berakhir tragis. 

Satwa laut dilindungi itu akhirnya dinyatakan mati pada Selasa (4/8/2026) sekitar pukul 00.00 WIB setelah sebelumnya selama berjam-jam berjuang untuk dikembalikan ke laut.

Bangkai hiu berukuran sekitar 5 meter itu dikuburkan di bibir Pantai Sanghiangkalang menggunakan alat berat excavator. 

Proses penguburan menarik perhatian ratusan warga yang berdatangan ke lokasi untuk menyaksikan secara langsung. Saat dievakuasi, bangkai hiu sudah mulai diserbu lalat.

Perwakilan Pengawasan Sumber Daya Kelautan dan Perikanan (PSDKP) Kabupaten Pangandaran, Deni Sugia Permana, mengatakan sejak hiu pertama kali terdampar pada Senin (3/8/2026) petang, pihaknya bersama nelayan sudah berupaya maksimal menyelamatkan satwa tersebut.

Menurutnya, hiu sempat didorong kembali ke perairan yang lebih dalam selama sekitar dua jam. Tapi, hiu itu kembali ke arah bibir pantai hingga akhirnya tidak mampu bertahan.

"Ada sekitar dua jam kita berusaha menggeser hiu ke tengah laut, tapi tetap kembali ke darat. Terus ketahuan matinya jam 12 malam," ujar Deni kepada sejumlah wartawan di lokasi TKP, Selasa pagi.

JAKARTA, KOMPASTV - Seorang karyawan bank keliling berinisial PG diduga menjadi korban penyekapan, penganiayaan, hingga pelecehan seksual oleh lima rekan kerjanya di Kecamatan Panongan, Kabupaten Tangerang, Banten.

Aksi kekerasan tersebut terekam dalam video yang kemudian viral di media sosial.

Dalam rekaman, korban terlihat mengalami luka di wajah dan diduga menjadi korban kekerasan fisik oleh para pelaku.

Kuasa hukum korban, Risman Harefa, mengatakan kejadian bermula saat korban hendak mengundurkan diri dari pekerjaannya dan mengembalikan aset perusahaan kepada atasannya.

Namun, korban diduga ditahan hingga akhirnya lima rekan kerjanya datang dan melakukan penganiayaan.

"Awalnya klien kami bekerja di unit usaha koperasi atau bank keliling di Panongan. Karena merasa usaha tersebut tidak benar, akhirnya dia mengundurkan diri dan mengembalikan aset. Namun saat itu bosnya tidak menerima," ujar Risman.

Menurut Risman, korban diduga dianiaya bersama-sama oleh lima orang hingga mengalami luka.

Polisi kini melakukan penyelidikan dengan meminta keterangan korban serta mendalami motif dan lokasi kejadian.

Kasi Humas Polresta Tangerang, Ipda Tri Leksono, mengatakan pihaknya masih melakukan pendalaman terkait laporan tersebut.

"Korban sudah diperiksa. Selanjutnya kita akan menyelidiki dan mendalami motif sebenarnya yang terjadi," ujar Ipda Tri Leksono.

One month after the launch of the Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City, one of the citizens' main concerns is likely how the welfare systems of the former Gwangju City and Jeollanam-do will be integrated. However, coupled with financial issues, it appears it will take quite some time before equitable support or benefits are available. Reporter Kim Ho reports.

[Report]

This is the Culture Welfare Card provided to young people by the Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City.

The support amount is 250,000 won per person per year.

It can be used for cultural activities, such as attending performances or purchasing books, or for self-development.

The recipients are young people residing in the 22 cities and counties of the former Jeollanam-do.

It is not provided to young people in the Gwangju region.

[Kang Geon-woo / Team Leader, Youth Support Team, Gwangju Metropolitan City: "This is a project that has been ongoing since 2022 (prior to the administrative merger). This year, we are proceeding with a budget of 28.4 billion won (combining city and county funds), but if we expand it to include Gwangju, the total will be around 58.4 billion won, meaning an increase of approximately 30 billion won."]

There are hundreds of policies directly connected to citizens' lives, such as welfare systems, that the former Gwangju City and Jeollanam-do have each pursued.

Some projects are being conducted in only one location, and even for similar projects, there are quite a few cases where the specific target recipients or scale of support differ.

In the case of the shingles vaccination support program, the former Gwangju City limits eligibility to recipients of basic livelihood security aged 65 or older, whereas the former Jeollanam-do extends support to the near-poverty group and the disabled.

The integrated special city plans to integrate policies in stages, but the scale of the increased financial burden is considerable.

The Special Act on Administrative Integration stipulates that various benefits enjoyed by citizens in Gwangju City or Jeollanam-do must not be lost due to administrative integration.

[Min Hyung-bae / Mayor of Jeollanam-Gwangju Integrated Special City: "Policy integration is a much more difficult issue than institutional integration. This is because it is not easy to coordinate as it directly involves the budget and citizens. Therefore, we have no choice but to proceed with the current system this year."]

If differing policies persist for a long time, this situation could act as a source of inter-regional conflict.

Attention is focused on whether a clever solution can be found to minimize the financial burden while maximizing the sense of efficacy of integration.

This is Kim Ho from KBS News.

Doa Rabu Wekasan merupakan salah satu amalan yang banyak diamalkan oleh sebagian umat Islam, khususnya di Indonesia, pada hari Rabu terakhir bulan Safar. 

Tradisi ini dilakukan sebagai bentuk ikhtiar memohon perlindungan, keselamatan, dan keberkahan kepada Allah SWT dari berbagai musibah dan bala.

Nak... Maaf, Hari Ini Ayah Belum Bawa Uang | Lagu Haru Tentang Perjuangan Seorang Ayah

Tidak semua hari berpihak kepada seorang ayah. Ada hari ketika sejak pagi mencari rezeki, belum satu rupiah pun didapat. Di tengah perjuangan, ban gerobak bocor, tenaga semakin habis, sementara di rumah ada keluarga yang sedang menunggu kepulangannya.

Lagu ini terinspirasi dari kisah nyata yang dialami banyak ayah, pedagang kecil, buruh, sopir, dan para pencari nafkah yang tetap berjuang meski berkali-kali diuji kehidupan. Bukan karena mereka tidak ingin memberi yang terbaik, tetapi karena rezeki memang tidak selalu datang sesuai harapan.

Semoga lagu ini menjadi pengingat bahwa di balik wajah seorang ayah yang terlihat tegar, ada banyak luka dan perjuangan yang sering ia sembunyikan demi keluarganya.

Jika lagu ini mengingatkanmu pada perjuangan ayahmu atau perjuanganmu sendiri sebagai seorang ayah, tuliskan di kolom komentar:

"Semoga semua ayah yang sedang berjuang dimudahkan rezekinya. Aamiin."

Semoga setiap ayah yang sedang berjuang hari ini selalu diberi kesehatan, kekuatan, dan rezeki yang halal serta berkah. Jangan pernah menyerah, karena di rumah selalu ada keluarga yang menunggu kepulanganmu. ❤️

पेट्रोल, डीजल और ATF के निर्यात पर विंडफॉल टैक्स बढ़ाया गया, घरेलू ईंधन कीमतों पर तत्काल असर नहीं।
उत्तराखंड सरकार ने 1 लाख औद्योगिक रोजगार सृजित करने के लक्ष्य के साथ ₹50,000 करोड़ निवेश आकर्षित करने की योजना बनाई।
सावन के पहले सोमवार पर हरिद्वार समेत देशभर के प्रमुख शिवालयों में करोड़ों श्रद्धालुओं ने दर्शन किए।
पाकिस्तान के खैबर पख्तूनख्वा में आत्मघाती हमले में 19 लोगों की मौत हुई, जिनमें 8 पुलिसकर्मी शामिल हैं।
पाकिस्तान ने माइक स्मिथ को नया बल्लेबाजी कोच नियुक्त किया।
जम्मू-कश्मीर के आकिब नबी को पहली बार भारतीय टेस्ट टीम में शामिल किया गया।
कॉमनवेल्थ खेलों में भारत ने 39 पदकों के साथ चौथा स्थान हासिल किया।
असम बाढ़ पीड़ितों के बीच अभिनेता रणदीप हुड्डा राहत कार्य में पहुंचे, जबकि कार्तिक आर्यन ने ₹1 करोड़ की सहायता दी।
रणबीर कपूर की फिल्म रामायण को लेकर रामलीला महासंघ ने रिलीज से पहले फिल्म दिखाने की मांग की।
महिला पहलवान यौन शोषण मामले में बृजभूषण सिंह बरी हुए, जबकि विनेश फोगाट ने हाईकोर्ट जाने की बात कही।
प्रधानमंत्री मोदी को अपशब्द कहने वाली युवती के खिलाफ FIR नहीं होगी, दिल्ली पुलिस ने मामला बंद करने की जानकारी दी।

Kepedulian akan selalu menemukan jalannya untuk menghadirkan harapan.
Kementerian Sosial Republik Indonesia melalui Sentra Tumou Tou Manado menyelenggarakan Bakti Sosial di Kabupaten Boalemo, Provinsi Gorontalo, sebagai wujud nyata hadirnya negara di tengah masyarakat.

Kegiatan ini dihadiri oleh Wakil Bupati Boalemo, Lahmuddin Hambali, S.Sos., M.Si., Kepala Dinas Sosial dan PMD Kabupaten Boalemo, Syarifuddin Lamusu, S.E., M.M., serta Kepala Subbagian Tata Usaha Sentra Tumou Tou Manado, Den Ardani Adigus Sujatmiko, yang mewakili Kepala Sentra Tumou Tou Manado.

Berbagai layanan diberikan secara langsung, mulai dari pemeriksaan kesehatan gratis, khitanan massal, hingga program Pekerja Sosial Goes to School di SMP Negeri 1 Tilamuta sebagai upaya memperkuat kepedulian dan perlindungan bagi generasi muda.

Pada kesempatan ini, Kementerian Sosial juga menyalurkan Bantuan Asistensi Rehabilitasi Sosial atau ATENSI kepada 140 penerima manfaat dari klaster anak, penyandang disabilitas, lanjut usia, dan kelompok rentan, dengan total nilai bantuan mencapai Rp522.150.475.

Lebih dari sekadar bantuan, setiap layanan yang diberikan adalah wujud kepedulian, penguatan, dan harapan untuk kehidupan yang lebih baik.

Melalui sinergi bersama pemerintah daerah, Kementerian Sosial Republik Indonesia terus berkomitmen menghadirkan pelayanan sosial yang inklusif, menjangkau yang membutuhkan, dan menguatkan masyarakat menuju Indonesia yang lebih sejahtera.

TRIBUN-VIDEO.COM - Sebanyak 5 penumpang tewas dalam insiden terbakarnya Kapal Motor Penumpang (KMP) Mutiara Sentosa II di perairan utara Sumenep, Madura, Jawa Timur, pada Minggu (2/8/2026) lalu.

Ratusan penumpang lainnya selamat dan telah dievakuasi ke darat.

Tewasnya kelima korban tersebut ternyata bukan akibat luka bakar akibat kebakaran.

Korban meninggal karena diduga karena sesak napas karena asap kebakaran.

Hal ini disampaikan Kabiddokes Polda Jatim, Kombes Pol dr Wahono Edhi P.

dr Wahono mengatakan, penyebab korban meninggal dunia diduga karena sesak napas karena asap.

Selain itu korban saat melompat kehilangan kesadaran hingga terombang-ambing di laut. 

Ada juga yang meninggal karena mengalami kondisi lemas akibat kesulitan berenang dan tak sengaja menelan air laut yang banyak mengandung garam.

Tak satu pun dari kelima korban meninggal dunia itu akibat luka bakar. 

"Lemas ini bisa karena memang kondisinya lemah dari awal, atau bisa jadi banyak minum air laut garam, ini membuat lemas. Jadi, rata-rata korban ini karena itu. Tidak ada yang meninggal karena luka bakar. Ini jelas ya," ujar Kombes Pol dr Wahono Edhi, saat konferensi pers di Lobby Ruang Immunotherapy RS Bhayangkara Surabaya, Senin (3/8/2026) sore. 

dr Wahono menegaskan, pihaknya masih terus menjalankan Operasi DVI selama tenggat waktu yang ditentukan oleh Tim Basarnas yang melakukan proses pencarian terhadap korban. 

Masyarakat yang merasa anggota keluarganya menjadi korban hilang dalam insiden tersebut, dapat segera menghubungi Tim DVI Polda Jatim melalui nomor telepon 085-9044-7911. 

"Kami harapkan peran serta seluruh masyarakat untuk mempercepat manakala ada keluarga yang hilang sama kami," pungkasnya. (*)

For decades, Utah's Elbert D. Thomas represented Latter-day Saints on the national stage as one of the most influential members of Congress you've probably never heard of. In this episode of Church History Matters, Scott Woodward and Casey Griffiths explore the remarkable life and political career of the faithful Latter-day Saint, educator, missionary, and U.S. Senator who served during some of the most pivotal years in American history.

After serving a five-year mission in Japan, Thomas brought a global perspective to Washington, D.C., where he became a leading advocate for workers' rights, public education, scientific research, and social welfare during the Great Depression. Scott and Casey examine his strong support of Franklin D. Roosevelt's New Deal programs, his efforts to strengthen labor protections, expand educational opportunities, and help establish institutions such as the National Science Foundation. They also discuss his role in promoting the Civilian Conservation Corps, support for veterans' education, and his work toward greater federal investment in education and public welfare.

The conversation also highlights Thomas's international vision. Long before the end of World War II, he warned about the persecution of European Jews, advocated for Jewish refugees fleeing Nazi oppression, and later became a vocal supporter of the newly formed United Nations and America's leadership in building a more peaceful postwar world. His experiences as an LDS missionary in Japan shaped his lifelong commitment to diplomacy, religious understanding, and international cooperation.

How did a devoted Latter-day Saint become one of the Senate's most progressive voices? Why did his impressive political career end amid the political tensions of the early Cold War? Join Scott and Casey as they uncover the fascinating story of Elbert D. Thomas and explore how his faith, education, and public service intersected during one of America's most consequential eras.

35 years cold. 6 cells worth of DNA. One pink-haired genealogist. ⬇️

Roxanne Wood was murdered in her home in Niles, Michigan in February 1987. Her husband Terry was never charged, but he was never cleared either. For 35 years, a small town called him "Slash" to his face. The real killer was a stranger who lived a few miles away and had never been in the case file.

The case was cracked by genetic genealogy using a DNA sample so degraded that experts called it unsolvable, and a genealogist named Gabriella Vargas who disagreed. She built a family tree back to the 1820s and came up with a name in four days. An undercover trooper bummed a cigarette off the suspect outside a laundromat to get the confirmation sample. The match was one in billions.

Ed covers the full story... Roxanne's victimology, the cold case, the genealogy work, the exoneration, and an ending that will stay with you. The perfect first episode to kick off August's Killer Connections block.

Thirty years ago, the People's Republic of China ratified the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea. Since then, Beijing has frequently invoked UNCLOS to support its maritime claims and legal positions, while advancing interpretations of the Convention that many other states –but not all – reject. 

This June the China Institute for Marine Affairs under the Ministry of Natural Resources marked the 30-year anniversary with an extensive report providing Beijing's interpretation of UNCLOS, including its account of the 2016 arbitral award that found China’s expansive maritime claims in the South China Sea as lacking a legal basis under the Convention. 

To examine the PRC’s evolving interpretation of UNCLOS and Chinese maritime activities, and how both are being used to advance Chinese interests, I’m joined today by Dr. Peter Dutton. Peter is a Senior Research Scholar in law and senior fellow in the Paul Tsai China Center at Yale Law School. Previously, he held several positions at the U.S. Naval War College, including as director of the China Maritime Studies Institute. He served in the US Navy for more than 40 years in several capacities, including as a Judge Advocate and naval flight officer.

MPLS Ramah dilaksanakan dengan mengedepankan prinsip aman, nyaman, menyenangkan, inklusif, edukatif, dan bebas dari segala bentuk perundungan maupun kekerasan. Seluruh rangkaian kegiatan dirancang agar peserta didik memperoleh pengalaman belajar yang positif melalui berbagai aktivitas yang kreatif, interaktif, dan sesuai dengan karakteristik anak usia sekolah dasar.

Melalui kegiatan ini, peserta didik diperkenalkan dengan visi, misi, serta budaya positif SDN Sambirobyong 2 sebagai sekolah yang berkomitmen menciptakan lingkungan belajar yang religius, disiplin, peduli, berintegritas, dan berorientasi pada prestasi. Selain itu, siswa juga dikenalkan dengan berbagai fasilitas sekolah, program unggulan, kegiatan ekstrakurikuler, serta pembiasaan baik yang menjadi bagian dari kehidupan sehari-hari di sekolah.

MPLS Ramah juga menjadi sarana untuk menanamkan nilai-nilai karakter yang meliputi keimanan dan ketakwaan kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Esa, kejujuran, tanggung jawab, kedisiplinan, kerja sama, gotong royong, kepedulian terhadap sesama, cinta lingkungan, serta semangat belajar sepanjang hayat. Lebih dari sekadar kegiatan pengenalan sekolah, MPLS Ramah merupakan awal perjalanan pendidikan yang bermakna bagi setiap peserta didik. Melalui kebersamaan antara sekolah, guru, orang tua, dan seluruh warga sekolah, diharapkan tercipta sinergi yang kuat dalam mendukung tumbuh kembang anak secara optimal, baik dalam aspek akademik maupun pembentukan karakter.

Most businesses don’t have a people problem — they have a process problem.

In this video, Matthew breaks down how mapping your workflows helps you see exactly how work moves through your business — from the initial enquiry and quote through to delivery and follow-up.

Once the process is visible, you can identify what needs to be:

✅ Simplified
✅ Automated
✅ Delegated
✅ Removed completely

You can’t scale a business when every process lives inside someone’s head. Map it, improve it and build systems that allow the business to operate without relying on you for everything.

Stop managing chaos. Start building a business that runs by design.

My name is Franz Lang, a German-Hongkongese independent linguist, language enthusiast, serial traveller and movie buff. I am now fully quadrilingual, speaking French, German, Cantonese and English fluently. So what about Payam? A Persian student in one of my seminars once gave a brilliant presentation on poetic meter in classical texts. Afterwards, I complimented him and asked about the meaning of his name, Payam. He told me it meant "message," and it felt beautifully fitting. Ever since, when I hear this name, I think of it not just as a sequence of sounds—the soft initial 'p', the open 'a', the final 'm'—but as a bearer of meaning itself, a quiet testament to the Persian language's deep appreciation for communication and lyrical expression.

Payam is a popular male given name of Persian origin, meaning "message" or "news." It is common in Iran and among the Persian-speaking diaspora. The name carries a poetic and communicative meaning, fitting into the rich linguistic and literary tradition of the Farsi language, and is frequently encountered in Middle Eastern contexts.

Shen Yisi—known globally as the "Fourth Princess" and the singular genius behind chart-topping hits—shed her fame and anonymity for love, marrying Lu Jingxing and becoming a full-time housewife for three years. She ghostwrote songs for her husband, propelling him to the pinnacle of the industry as a "hitmaker," and even endured hormone injections to conceive—ballooning to 300 pounds in the process—only to be met with utter betrayal and humiliation.
At a celebratory banquet, Lu Jingxing publicly declared his mistress, Wen Ruosheng, his "soulmate." His vicious mother, Qian Jinse, conspired to falsely accuse Shen Yisi of wearing a fake necklace; she slapped Shen to the ground—causing the necklace to snap and cut into her neck, drawing blood—and forced her to sign divorce papers. Just as Lu Jingxing was about to stomp his shoe onto her face, Shen Yisi’s three brothers—global tycoon Shen Boyuan, genius scientist Shen Zhongqi, and music superstar Shen Shuyan—made a commanding entrance to rescue their sister.
With her heart hardened, Shen Yisi regained her stunning figure and stepped onto the Voice of Dragon Nation grand finale stage wearing a mask, performing under the alias "Princess Si." She stunned the audience with legendary live renditions of hits like "Bubbles" and "Pointing at the Moon," hitting high notes so powerful they shattered Lu Jingxing’s trophy on the spot. Finally, she unmasked herself before hundreds of millions of viewers, proving her identity as "Princess Si" and tearing away the mask of lies Lu Jingxing had worn for six years.
Shen Yisi founded Nirvana Entertainment; though Lu Jingxing tried to blacklist her across the industry, she staged a spectacular comeback through sheer talent. She secured a multi-million-dollar advertising contract, launched three smash-hit singles that outperformed twelve of the Lu family's albums, and silenced accusations of lip-syncing by performing an a cappella set during a livestream watched by thirty million people. She even achieved legendary status by improvising the song "The Ordinary Road" on the spot. In the final showdown over a 300-million-yuan copyright dispute, Lu Jingxing’s attempt to sing live resulted in a disastrous vocal crack, exposing his fraud and causing his six-year charade to collapse completely.
Shen Yisi not only reclaimed her throne in the music world but also utterly crushed the Lu Group, achieving a satisfying revenge. Standing side-by-side with Lu Jingshen—the man who had always protected her—she embarked on a brand-new life of her own.

The Attorney General's Office (AGO) of the Republic of Indonesia has responded to former Deputy Attorney General for Special Crimes (Jampidsus), Febrie Adriansyah's plan to file two pretrial motions. Febrie plans to file two pretrial motions related to the handling of an alleged money laundering (TPPU) case at the South Jakarta District Court. "Go ahead. It's the right of the suspect and his legal counsel to file a pretrial motion. This is also regulated in the Criminal Procedure Code," said Anang Supriatna, Head of the Attorney General's Office's Legal Information Center, in a statement on Tuesday (August 4, 2026).

Previously, the two lawsuits concerned the Attorney General's Office's coercive efforts to name suspects in the alleged TPPU case and to detain them. The two lawsuits also concerned the suspect's determination in the alleged corruption and money laundering case, and the searches and seizures conducted by the Jakarta Metropolitan Police and/or the Corruption Eradication Commission (Kortas Tipikor).

"Then, our legal team filed two pretrial motions. So, there are two pretrial motions," said Firman Wijaya, a member of the legal team for former Jampidsus Febrie Adriansyah, at a press conference in Senayan, Jakarta, Tuesday (August 4, 2026).

Firman explained that the two motions were filed separately because the objects of the actions being challenged were different. "Also, because the objects and actions are being challenged differently, the test cases will be different," he said.

"Then, the second motion concerns the forced determination of suspect status in alleged corruption and money laundering crimes, as well as searches and seizures as coercive measures carried out by our colleagues from the police, the Jakarta Metropolitan Police, in this case, and/or the Corruption Eradication Commission (Kortas Tipidkor)," he said.

Furthermore, Firman explained why his client would pursue further legal action by filing a pretrial motion.

According to him, this action is being taken to test the validity, legitimacy, and authentication of the legal process to ensure it complies with the principles of criminal procedure law.

"Therefore, regarding the coercive measures taken against our client, we certainly want to test their validity, including their authentication, in our identification," he said.

"Furthermore, we want to determine whether the legal process was indeed clear and clean, in accordance with the principles of criminal procedure law."

Previously, Febrie's other attorney, Febri Diansyah, stated that his office had found nine irregularities in the handling of the alleged money laundering case ensnaring his client.

"To date, we have identified at least nine irregularities or indications of violations of procedural law in the handling of the case involving suspect Mr. FA, which is being handled by the Attorney General's Office," Febri said on Monday (August 3, 2026).

According to him, these irregularities include the discovery of the consolidation of two criminal cases into one investigation warrant, which was deemed procedural.

Basic Entrance Exam Q&A

2. How Do Universities Select Students?

Hello.

This is Friendly Yes Secondary Education.

This is the second question in the Basic Entrance Exam Q&A section for the First Child College Entrance Exam.

Here is today's question:

How do universities select students?

I frequently receive questions like this when consulting with parents.

Don't universities ultimately just select students with the highest grades first?

Between students with good GPAs and students who did well on the CSAT, who do they prefer?

What exactly are they looking for when selecting students in the Comprehensive Student Record Screening?

Why do acceptance and rejection results differ from university to university even with the same grades?

First, let me state the conclusion.

Universities do not simply select students with high grades.

Universities select students who fit their educational goals and ideal student profiles, and who have the potential to study successfully within the university and their respective majors after admission.

Therefore, the students recruited by each university differ,

the screening methods differ, and the evaluation criteria also differ.

To properly understand college admissions, you must understand the three processes of recruitment, screening, and evaluation together.

Today, rather than re-explaining admissions terminology, we will focus on why universities select students and the philosophy and criteria they use for selection.

First, why do universities select students?

A university is not merely an institution that grants degrees to high school graduates.

Each university has its own unique educational goals; it teaches and conducts research to cultivate talent needed by society.

Some universities emphasize creative talent,

others emphasize talent that contributes to the community, and

others place importance on academic inquiry skills or practical competencies.

Even within the same university, the required competencies may differ depending on the department and major.

For example, in engineering fields, the ability to analyze and solve problems based on mathematics and science may be important.

In the humanities, the ability to read and interpret texts and logically express one's thoughts may be important.

In the social sciences, the ability to analyze social phenomena and view problems from various perspectives may be necessary. In the arts and physical education fields, practical skills, creativity, and a consistent training process can be evaluated as important factors.

In the medical and health sciences fields, not only high academic ability but also respect for life, responsibility, communication skills, and an attitude toward the community can be important.

Therefore, universities do not look solely at an applicant's grades; they seek to verify whether the student is prepared to study at the university and possesses the necessary competencies and attitudes for the relevant field.

This is the purpose of university selection.

So, how do universities recruit students?

First, universities determine how many students to select from each recruitment unit.

They may select students by department,

or by faculty or academic division,

and recently, some universities recruit students in the form of "autonomous majors" or "no major" programs, allowing students to explore and select a major after admission.

The university then presents the number of students to be selected, eligibility requirements, selection methods, and evaluation criteria in the admissions guidelines.

This is why the admissions guidelines are the first official document parents should check when verifying university admissions information.

The admissions guidelines do not simply list the number of students to be recruited. It contains information on which students are eligible to apply, how student records and the CSAT are reflected, whether interviews and essay tests are conducted, whether there are minimum CSAT requirements, and the selection schedule.

Therefore, a university's selection philosophy does not remain merely an abstract slogan.

It is concretely reflected in actual recruitment units, screening methods, and evaluation criteria.

Next is the admission process.

An admission process is a selection method used by a university to select students.

Universities do not select all students using the same method.

They operate various admission processes to identify the diverse strengths of students.

Students who have demonstrated consistent achievement in schoolwork and GPA may have an advantage in the Student Record-based Subject-specific Admission Process.

Students who have demonstrated their growth process and capabilities through classes, research, subject selection, and overall school life may have an advantage in the Student Record-based Comprehensive Admission Process.

Di waktu yang bersamaan, Iran justru melancarkan serangan ke AS.

Serangan itu dilakukan seusai drone MQ-9 Reaper AS berada di atas selat Hormuz.

Sistem pertahanan Iran menargetkan dan menembak jatuh drone kebanggaan AS pada Senin (3/8).

Pejabat Iran belum memberikan detail terkait peristiwa tersebut.

Sementara hingga saat ini, AS belum buka suara terkait klaim Iran.

Dengan begitu, insiden ini menambah jumlah drone MQ-9 Reaper AS yang ditembak jatuh Teheran.

Tercatat setidaknya 42 drone kebanggaan AS dibombardir Korps Garda Revolusi Islam Iran (IRGC).

Pesawat MQ-9 Reaper dioperasikan oleh Angkatan Udara AS.

Biasanya drone ini digunakan untuk misi intelijen, pengawasan, pengintaian, dan serangan.

Sementara itu, Militer Amerika Serikat merilis rekaman yang memperlihatkan operasi penegakan blokade maritim terhadap Iran.

Dalam rekaman yang diunggah Komando Pusat Amerika Serikat (CENTCOM) di X pada Senin (3/8), terdengar seorang perwira militer memberikan peringatan melalui radio ke sebuah kapal komersial.

Kapal tersebut diperintahkan mengubah haluan.

Jika tidak mematuhi, militer AS memperingatkan akan mengambil tindakan dengan menggunakan kekuatan.

CENTCOM menyebut, hingga 3 Agustus, pasukan AS telah mengalihkan rute 44 kapal komersial selama operasi tersebut.

Selain itu, dua kapal dihentikan atau dilumpuhkan.

Sementara dua kapal lainnya dinaiki untuk pemeriksaan.

Operasi blokade ini dilakukan setelah Amerika Serikat melancarkan serangan terhadap sejumlah target di Iran, termasuk fasilitas nuklir, pada Juni lalu.

Menanggapi laporan tersebut, Menteri ESDM, Bahlil Lahadalia memberikan bantahan. Ia menegaskan bahwa saat ini hanya ada satu BUMN tambang yang beroperasi di kawasan Raja Ampat, yakni PT Gag Nikel.

"Tanyakan kepada yang memberikan informasi. Saya kan sudah bilang, kalau di Raja Ampat itu izin yang masih beroperasi tinggal punya BUMN, PT Gag Nikel. Itu kan barang dari sebelum saya lahir juga sudah ada," kata Bahlil kepada wartawan di Kementerian ESDM, Jakarta.

Bahlil pun memastikan bahwa sudah tidak terdapat perizinan pertambangan di kawasan tersebut selain PT Gag Nikel.

Following the formation of the 8th Central Pay Commission (8th CPC), the National Council for Pension and Salary (JCM) and employee organizations have demanded significant increases in pensions and salaries. These key demands of pensioners and employees are expected to be implemented from January 1, 2026. 


The main demands put forth by the employees' unions and pensioners are as follows:

Restoration of Old Pension Scheme (OPS): The most prominent demand of the employees' unions is the reintroduction of the old pension scheme, which is a major issue for the employees who joined service after January 1, 2004.

Increase in fitment factor: As against 2.57 in the 7th CPC, employees have demanded a fitment factor of3.83 or 3.25 for the 8th Pay Commission .

Increase in minimum wage and pension: The minimum basic pay is expected to be increased from the current ₹18,000 to ₹69,000 per month. Additionally, the minimum pension is expected to increase from ₹9,000 to over ₹25,000.

Determination of Pension:It has been demanded to give 67% of the last drawn pay as pension to retired employees.

Family Pension: There has been a demand to fix the family pension at 50% of the last salary.

Pension revision in 5 years: Pensioners are demanding that pension revision should be doneevery 5 years instead of every 10 years.

Other key demands:

Fixed medical allowance: There is a demand to increase the medical allowance from ₹1,000 to ₹20,000 per month in non-CGHS areas.

One Rank One Pension (OROP): There is a demand to implement the 'One Rank One Pension' system for civil servants like defence personnel.

Restoration of Commission: Demand for full restoration of pension after 11 years.

Leave Encashment: There is a demand to increase the leave encashment on retirement from 300 days to 400 days.

Increase in Gratuity Limit: There has been a demand to increase the maximum gratuity (DCRG) limit to ₹75 lakh.

Age-based additional pension: There is a demand to introduce additional pension (from 5% to 100%) from the age of 65 years.

Restoration of Pension Commutation: There has been a demand to restore commutation of pension after 11 years. 

Military Service Pay (MSP) Increase: The Army has recommended increasing the MSP or maintaining it at the current level. The Army Pay Commission Cell (APC Cell) has pushed for an increase in the MSP for JCOs/ORs.

Disability/War Injury Pension: There has been a demand to improve the rules of disability pension and link it with the new pay matrix.

Merger of Levels from 18: The 7th Pay Commission proposes to reduce the existing 18 pay levels and merge them into only 7-8 broad pay scales .

Merging lower levels: To eliminate the significant pay gap between lower-level employees (Level 2 to Level 5), they could be merged into a higher pay grade. For example, there are calls to merge Level 2 with Level 3, and Level 4 with Level 5.

Merger of DA: When the dearness allowance (DA) crosses 25%, it has been demanded to be completely merged with the basic pay. 

Increase in minimum pay (demand for ₹69,000): The starting basic pay at the lower level (Level-1) of the pay matrix is ​​proposed to beincreased from ₹18,000 to ₹69,000 .

Elimination of pay disparities: Bringing uniformity in pay scales across different departments.

Career Growth: Ensuring better promotion opportunities and career growth for the employees.

Reducing complexity: Making pay structures less complex and more transparent. 

If this proposal is implemented, employees in the lower pay scales could see a significant increase (20-35%) in their basic pay. 


Key demands of Railways in the 8th Pay Commission:

Dearness Allowance and Arrears: There is a demand to merge the Dearness Allowance (DA) with the basic pay if it exceeds 50% for the pay applicable from January 1, 2026.

Kilometre Allowance (KMA): Kilometre Allowance and other allowances for running staff (loco pilots, guards) increased by up to 25%.

Old Pension Scheme (OPS): Railway employees' unions are demanding the restoration of the old pension scheme.

Pay Anomalies: Demand for improvement in classification of posts and pay scales by Technical Supervisor (IRTSA). 

Railways' Preparation:
To handle the burden of salary hike, Railways is cutting its operational costs to absorb the financial impact of 8th CPC.

Has President Prabowo Subianto's communication style been effective in building public trust? Why do some political communication academics believe that government communication still needs strengthening?

This video objectively discusses various academic criticisms of President Prabowo's political communication, including:

✔ Is public communication more of a monologue than a dialogue?
✔ Why are criticisms often answered in general terms, rather than in substance?
✔ What is the impact of using rhetorical labels in political communication?
✔ Why do people need technical explanations, not just grand visions?
✔ How does crisis communication affect public trust?

This discussion is not intended to attack President Prabowo personally, but rather examines government communication from the perspectives of political communication, deliberative democracy, policy communication, crisis communication, and Christian theology.

Furthermore, this video invites us to consider the example of the Lord Jesus Christ when he met Bartimaeus (Mark 10:46–52). Although Jesus recognized Bartimaeus's need, He still asked,

"What do you want me to do for you?"

From this incident, we learn that good communication is not just about providing answers, but also about a willingness to listen, respecting human dignity, and building a dialogue filled with love and truth.

May this discussion serve as a reflection for every leader, whether in government, church, family, or the world of ministry.

Soli Deo Gloria.

Banjir di Kota Padang: 3 Kecamatan Terdampak, Ratusan Warga di Evakuasi

Badan Nasional Penanggulangan Bencana (BNPB) mengerahkan tim gabungan untuk mengevakuasi warga yang terdampak banjir di Kota Padang, Sumatera Barat.
Proses evakuasi dilakukan menggunakan perahu setelah banjir menggenangi sejumlah kawasan permukiman dan akses jalan.

Kepala Pusat Data, Informasi, dan Komunikasi Kebencanaan BNPB Abdul Muhari mengatakan banjir dipicu hujan berintensitas tinggi yang mengguyur Kota Padang sejak, Senin (3/8/2026) pukul 11.00 hingga 17.00 W.I.B.

"Hujan lebat berdurasi panjang memicu genangan air yang meluap ke kawasan permukiman warga serta ruas jalan utama di beberapa titik. Merespons kondisi tersebut, tim gabungan BPBD Kota Padang bergerak menerjunkan perahu polietilen guna mengevakuasi warga ke lokasi aman," kata dia, Senin.

Berdasarkan data Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) Kota Padang, banjir berdampak pada tiga kecamatan, yakni Kuranji, Koto Tangah, dan Bungus Teluk Kabung.

Di Kecamatan Kuranji, wilayah yang terdampak meliputi Kelurahan Lapau Munggu, Komplek Wahana, Kampuang Tanjung, Pasar Lalang, hingga Gunung Sarik. Sementara di Kecamatan Koto Tangah, genangan air merendam Kelurahan Aia Pacah, kawasan belakang RSUD, serta Perumahan Green Mandiri. Adapun di Kecamatan Bungus Teluk Kabung, banjir dilaporkan melanda lima kelurahan.

Direktorat Pengendalian Operasi BNPB juga menerima laporan dari petugas di lapangan bahwa derasnya arus banjir di sejumlah ruas jalan sempat menghanyutkan beberapa kendaraan bermotor milik warga.

Abdul menyampaikan hujan masih mengguyur sebagian wilayah Kota Padang hingga Senin malam. Akibatnya, genangan air di sejumlah titik belum surut, sementara proses pendataan korban maupun kerugian masih terus dilakukan.

"Masyarakat yang berada di wilayah rawan diharapkan terus memantau informasi resmi dari pemerintah daerah dan BPBD setempat serta segera mengikuti arahan petugas apabila diperlukan evakuasi demi keselamatan bersama," kata dia.

BNPB menilai kewaspadaan masyarakat perlu terus ditingkatkan seiring adanya peringatan dini cuaca ekstrem dari Badan Meteorologi, Klimatologi, dan Geofisika (BMKG).

Sebelumnya, Direktorat Meteorologi BMKG mendeteksi kemunculan Bibit Siklon Tropis 94W di Laut Filipina yang berpotensi meningkatkan peluang hujan lebat di sejumlah wilayah, terutama di sebagian besar Sumatera bagian barat pada periode 3-5 Agustus.

Penang will issue a safety advisory for owners of heritage buildings following a wall collapse in Lebuh Armenian that injured two Sri Lankan tourists.

State Tourism and Creative Economy Committee chairman Wong Hon Wai said the incident underscored the need for greater attention to the structural safety of old and heritage buildings to prevent similar accidents.

Wong said the safety of heritage buildings must be prioritised as weakened structures could pose a danger to pedestrians and visitors.

He added George Town World Heritage Incorporated, together with the Penang Island City Council, has been asked to issue an advisory urging building owners to carry out safety inspections on their properties.

The state government is awaiting a full report from the relevant authorities to determine the cause of the collapse.

Wong also said his office is in contact with the Sri Lankan High Commission to provide assistance to the injured tourists.

He added that heritage building owners should be guided and supported in carrying out repairs and restoration works to ensure public safety.

Earlier, the Fire and Rescue Department said it received an emergency call at 1.11pm.

Stones and timber from a first-floor beam collapsed, injuring two Sri Lankan tourists.

The victims, aged 66 and 55, were given initial treatment at the scene before being taken to Penang Hospital for further treatment.

The VOC: A Company That Could Wage War Like a State

What if a company had the right to build forts, recruit soldiers, own a fleet, make treaties with other kingdoms, and even declare war?

It sounds like fiction. But about 400 years ago, it really happened.

In this documentary, we will explore the story of the VOC (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie), a Dutch trading company that grew into one of the most powerful organizations in world history. Starting with the spice trade, the VOC gradually acquired privileges usually reserved for states.

How did a company gain control of territory, influence kingdoms in the Indonesian archipelago, build forts, maintain its own army, and even run a government?

Why did a company that was once one of the richest organizations in the world ultimately collapse due to corruption, debt, and poor governance?

And most importantly, what lessons are still relevant for the modern world from the story of the VOC?

In this video, we will trace the history of the VOC chronologically, starting with:

The birth of the global spice trade
The establishment of the VOC in 1602
The privileges that made the VOC a nation
Trade, political, and military strategies in the archipelago
Batavia as the center of VOC power
The beginning of its decline due to corruption and debt
The dissolution of the VOC in 1799
The VOC's historical legacy that still influences the world today

This documentary is structured chronologically and aims to help us understand how economic power can develop into political and military power that changes the course of history.

Do you think a company should ever have as much power as the VOC?

Let us know your thoughts in the comments section.

Peatlands store more carbon than all the world's forests combined, yet for years they remained largely invisible in the national policy frameworks that define countries' commitments to climate, biodiversity, and land restoration. Across the world, governments had been working to change that, taking proactive steps to ensure that these ecosystems received the recognition, legal standing, and dedicated targets they deserved in Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), National Biodiversity Strategies and Action Plans (NBSAPs), and Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) commitments. The Global Peatlands Initiative was proud to walk alongside these governments in that journey, providing science, technical guidance, and a global platform to support and amplify their action.

This session brought together government representatives from ten countries: Colombia, the Republic of Congo, Chile, Uganda, Peru, Brazil, Germany, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Mongolia and Indonesia, each at a different stage of their national peatland policy journey, to share what that path had looked like in practice. Effective peatland action does not live in a single Ministry or Sector: conserving, restoring and sustainably managing peatlands cuts across the mandates of environment, agriculture, forestry, water, nature, climate change, land-use planning, energy, extractives, finance, health and infrastructure ministries and more, and rightfully and increasingly involves subnational governments, Indigenous Peoples and their communities, private sector and local communities. Yet for many years, peatlands fell through the cracks of national coordination, treated as a marginal concern by institutions that were not designed to manage them collectively. Speakers shared the creative ways their governments had found to change that, building dedicated peatland units and institutions, inter-ministerial committees, subnational coordination platforms, joint task teams, and multi-stakeholder mechanisms that allow science, policy, finance and practice to come together around a coherent national agenda.

As countries across the world entered a new round of NDC revision and NBSAP implementation under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, and as the peatland momentum grew, the question of how to effectively and durably embed peatlands into national commitments, and how governments organise themselves internally to deliver on them, had never been more urgent. This session was not about showcasing finished work, it was about opening an honest conversation between pioneers: what political and institutional entry points had worked, what evidence and tools made the case for inclusion, how countries had navigated the intersection of multiple Multilateral Environmental Agreements (the UNFCCC, CBD, UNCCD, and the Ramsar Convention) to build coherence rather than fragmentation, where ministerial mandates overlapped and how coherence was built rather than competition, how subnational levels, Indigenous Peoples, local communities and non-state actors were brought into the coordination architecture, and what support the GPI and the wider partnership could offer to countries just beginning this journey.

By bringing these national pathways into dialogue, the session aimed to accelerate collective learning, inspire and support countries earlier in their journey, and contribute to a shared roadmap and understanding of what good cross-sector coordination on peatlands can look like in the decade ahead, one in which peatlands are not the exception but the norm in national climate and nature commitments worldwide.

Speakers
● Julie van Offelen, Global Peatlands Initiative, UN Environment Programme
● Mirbel Epiquien, Government of Peru 
● Oscar Hernán Manrique, Government of Colombia
● Narcisse Ofoulou Tsamaka, Government of Republic of Congo
● Paula Otth, Government of Chile
● Lucy Iyango, Government of Uganda
● Iara Bueno Giacomini, Government of Brazil
● Uwe Ballhorn, Government of Germany
● Jean-Jacques Bambuta, Government of Democratic Republic of Congo
● Davaanyam Tegshjargal, Government of Mongolia
● Ristianto Pribadi, Government of Indonesia

About GPI4
The Fourth Meeting of the Partners of the Global Peatlands Initiative (GPI4) was co-hosted by UNEP and Peru's Ministry of Environment (MINAM) in Lima, Peru, from 30 June to 2 July 2026. It brought together governments, GPI partners, scientists, Indigenous Peoples and local communities, donors and practitioners under the theme “Peatlands as livelihoods and the conditions for their conservation and sustainable management.” Over three days, participants reflected on the Initiative's first decade and shaped priorities for the GPI 10-Year Strategic Plan.

Biasanya drone ini digunakan untuk misi intelijen, pengawasan, pengintaian, dan serangan.

Perjalanan MOTRIPS LINTAS PROVINSI menuju Kuningan masih berlanjut. Saat melintasi wilayah Sumedang, saya benar-benar menikmati jalan yang nyaman, pemandangan perbukitan, serta hamparan terasering yang memanjakan mata. Rasanya perjalanan terus mengalir tanpa beban.

Namun seperti biasa, perjalanan selalu punya kejutan. Di tengah asyik menikmati jalan, Google Maps kembali meminta saya berbelok ke kiri. Jalur yang dipilih membawa saya melewati kawasan Desa Wargaluyu, tepat di sekitar kantor desa. Karena belum mengenal daerah ini, saya pun kembali mengikuti arah navigasi, meski kali ini dengan sedikit rasa waswas. 😄

Tak lama kemudian, rasa deg-degan itu benar-benar muncul. Turunan yang cukup curam dipadukan dengan kondisi jalan yang kurang baik membuat saya harus ekstra hati-hati. Alhamdulillah cuaca sedang cerah, sehingga perjalanan tetap bisa dilalui dengan aman.

Semakin masuk ke dalam, suasana berubah menjadi pedesaan yang cukup ramai. Ternyata saya sudah berada di wilayah Kecamatan Tanjungkerta. Di balik jalur yang sempat membuat jantung berdebar, tersimpan suasana desa yang asri dan menjadi pengalaman baru yang menambah warna dalam perjalanan ini.

Begitulah perjalanan. Saat jalan mulus berakhir, bukan berarti keseruannya ikut selesai. Justru di situlah sering kali petualangan yang sebenarnya dimulai.

Melalui kegiatan ini, diharapkan peserta didik tidak hanya unggul dalam akademik, tetapi juga memiliki karakter Islami yang kokoh sebagai bekal menjadi generasi Qur'ani dan pemimpin masa depan.

Semoga ilmu yang disampaikan menjadi manfaat, pengingat, dan motivasi bagi seluruh peserta didik untuk terus memperbaiki diri serta meningkatkan kualitas iman dan amal.

Pemerintah Kabupaten Tangerang mendukung penuh Gerakan Nasional Pesantrenku Aman yang diinisiasi oleh Pengurus Besar Nahdltul Ulama (PBNU) melalui Rabithah Ma’ahid Islamiyyah (RMI) dan Satgas Penanggulangan Kekerasan (SAKA) Pesantren PBNU.

Hal tersebut disampaikan Sekretaris Daerah Kabupaten Tangerang Soma Atmaja saat dimintai keterangan usai Agenda Doa Bersama dan Deklarasi Pesantrenku Aman yang diselenggerakan di Pondok Pesantren Al Mubarok, Kabupaten Tangerang, (Sabtu. 01/8).

Soma menilai Gerakan Pesantrenku Aman bukan hanya sekadar seruan moral, melainkan sebagai bentuk kerja nyata kelembagaan yang harus dijalankan secara sistematis. Ia menegaskan komitmen untuk memperkuat gerakan ini agar pesantren benar-benar menjadi ruang yang aman bagi santri.

Ia mengugkapkan bahwa Pemerintah Kabupaten Tangerang menempatkan pesantren sebagai salah satu agenda prioritas pemerintah dengan berbagai program bagi pesantren, seperti perbaikan infrastruktur dan pemberian beasiswa bagi para santri yang berprestasi.

Leo got a perfect score on his Chinese listening test — and then four words from a convenience store cashier completely destroyed him. The words were 袋子要吗. If HSK audio makes sense to you but real people don't, this episode is why. Xiao Yue takes it apart: five reasons native Chinese is so hard to follow, four concrete ways to train your ears, and three lifesaver lines for the moment you're lost mid-conversation.

Leo 的中文听力考了满分，然后在便利店被四个字打败了——袋子要吗。这一期，小悦给出真人中文听不懂的五个真正原因：你在一个字一个字地捡，而我们是一碗一碗端过来的；真人说话会偷懒，音是会掉的（这样子说成酱紫、什么说成啥，而那个几乎没人这么念，大家说的是内个）；真实聊天里大概有三分之一的字根本不带信息；你不是听不懂，是听懂得太慢；还有——有时候对方是真的没在说普通话。最后是四个具体的练法，和三句听不懂时当场能用的救命话。

In this episode, you will learn:

You're not slow — you're listening character by character. Natives hear Chinese in chunks (我跟你说啊 / 你知道吧 / 行了行了 are single units, not separate words). It's the difference between recognizing a whole face and assembling the eyes, nose and mouth one at a time.
你不是反应慢，你是在一个字一个字地听。中国人听中文是成块听的（我跟你说啊、你知道吧、行了行了都是一整块，不是一个个字）。这就像认脸——你一眼看整张脸，而你现在是在拼五官。

Real speech drops sounds, and your textbook never taught you this: 这样子 → 酱紫, 什么 → 啥, 有没有 → 有木有, 知道了 loses its 知, and the 不 in 是不是 nearly vanishes. Biggest one: the dictionary says 那个, but 99 out of 100 people say 内个 — you've been waiting for a sound that never comes.
真人说话会掉音，课本从来不教：这样子说成酱紫、什么说成啥、有没有说成有木有、知道了常常只剩道了、是不是中间那个不又轻又短。最要命的是——字典标的是那个，可一百个人里九十九个说的是内个。你一直在等一个永远不会来的声音。

About a third of a real conversation carries zero information — 诶、那个、就是说啊、咱们那个 are padding while the speaker thinks. Chinese natives are 连蒙带猜 too: catch the verb and the noun (抓重点), let the rest flow out of your ears.
真实聊天里大概有三分之一的字不带任何信息——诶、那个、就是说啊、咱们那个，都是一边想一边垫在中间的。中国人自己听中文也是连蒙带猜：抓住动词和名词（抓重点），剩下的让它从耳朵里流走。

The deepest reason: you're not failing to understand, you're understanding too slowly — 后知后觉. While you replay one sentence, you miss the next five, because 一心不能二用. Learn to drop the word you missed on the spot; listening is crossing a river on stepping stones, you don't need every stone.
藏得最深的一条：你不是听不懂，是听懂得太慢——后知后觉。你忙着回想那一句的时候，后面五句一个字都没听见，因为一心不能二用。学会当场把没听懂的词扔掉：听真人说话像过河踩石头，你不用每一块都踩到。

Four ways to train: (1) listen to the SAME clip ten times, not ten new ones — no subtitles, then with, then off again; the words you miss are almost always words you already know. (2) Your ears can only understand what your mouth can say — learn their laziness through shadowing 影子跟读. (3) Switch to filler-heavy material. (4) Don't get addicted to 0.75x.
四个练法：（1）同一段听十遍，别听十段新的——不看字幕听、看字幕对、再关掉字幕听；你听不懂的地方多半是你早就认识的词。（2）你的耳朵只能听懂你嘴巴会说的东西——用影子跟读去学他们的懒。（3）换成废话多的材料。（4）零点七五倍速别上瘾。

Three lifesaver lines for the moment you're lost — and the third one changes everything: instead of pushing the whole sentence back, say the half you DID catch and stop: 你是说……明天……? They'll fill in the rest, rephrased. Plus 似懂非懂 is normal — good listening means keeping the conversation going even when you didn't catch it all.
听不懂时当场能用的三句话——第三句最厉害：别把整句话推回去，把你听懂的那一半说出来然后停住，你是说……明天……？对方会自动补上后面，还会换个说法再讲一遍。另外，似懂非懂很正常——听力好的标准不是每个字都听清，是没听清也能把这个天聊下去。

Dr. Ananta Singh Raghuvanshi, Chairperson & Founding Member of NAREDCO Mahi, marking 35 years in real estate, puts sustainability at the heart of India's urban future. She calls out water recycling, grey water management and energy alternatives — solar, wind, biomass and battery — as urgent priorities, not future goals. 

Sustainability, she stresses, is a shared responsibility between developers, governments and citizens alike. On urban planning, she advocates for infrastructure to precede residential growth, not follow it, and champions the 15-minute city model as the blueprint for India's next urban chapter. She cites Bela, a net-zero eco-village in Vidarbha, as a homegrown model worth scaling, alongside global leaders like Bhutan, Sweden and Denmark. Her sharpest challenge — India's metros, where the modern and ancient coexist, will be the hardest to transform.

Pemerintah Kota Bandar Lampung optimistis Kelurahan Gedong Air, Kecamatan Tanjungkarang Barat, mampu mewakili Provinsi Lampung pada Lomba Kelurahan Tingkat Nasional Tahun 2026. Optimisme tersebut disampaikan saat kunjungan Tim Penilai Lomba Kelurahan Tingkat Provinsi Lampung yang melakukan verifikasi lapangan di Kelurahan Gedong Air.

Kunjungan tim penilai didampingi langsung oleh Wali Kota Bandar Lampung Eva Dwiana bersama jajaran Pemerintah Kota Bandar Lampung. Penilaian tersebut merupakan bagian dari tahapan seleksi untuk menentukan kelurahan terbaik yang akan menjadi wakil Provinsi Lampung di tingkat nasional.

Eva Dwiana mengatakan, lomba kelurahan bukan sekadar ajang kompetisi administrasi, tetapi juga menjadi tolok ukur keberhasilan pemerintah kelurahan dalam memberikan pelayanan kepada masyarakat, memberdayakan potensi lokal, serta membangun sinergi dengan berbagai elemen masyarakat.

Menurutnya, Kelurahan Gedong Air memiliki sejumlah keunggulan yang menjadi nilai tambah dalam penilaian. Selain dikenal memiliki kehidupan masyarakat yang harmonis dan menjunjung tinggi nilai toleransi, kelurahan tersebut juga aktif melestarikan seni dan budaya daerah serta memiliki partisipasi masyarakat yang tinggi dalam mendukung berbagai program pembangunan.

Di sektor ekonomi, Gedong Air juga dinilai menunjukkan perkembangan yang positif melalui tumbuhnya pelaku Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM). Berbagai program pemberdayaan masyarakat terus dijalankan untuk meningkatkan kesejahteraan warga sekaligus memperkuat perekonomian lokal.

Masyarakat setempat juga dinilai aktif mendukung program strategis pemerintah, di antaranya penyediaan bahan pangan untuk Program Makan Bergizi Gratis serta pengembangan Koperasi Merah Putih yang menjadi salah satu program penguatan ekonomi berbasis masyarakat.

Eva berharap hasil penilaian tingkat provinsi dapat mengantarkan Kelurahan Gedong Air menjadi wakil Provinsi Lampung pada Lomba Kelurahan Tingkat Nasional Tahun 2026.

"Harapan kami, Kelurahan Gedong Air dapat memberikan hasil terbaik, mewakili Provinsi Lampung di tingkat nasional, sekaligus mengharumkan nama Kota Bandar Lampung melalui berbagai inovasi dan prestasi yang telah dicapai," ujar Eva Dwiana.

Melalui ajang tersebut, Pemerintah Kota Bandar Lampung berharap berbagai inovasi pelayanan publik, pemberdayaan masyarakat, dan pembangunan berbasis partisipasi warga dapat terus berkembang sehingga mampu meningkatkan kualitas pelayanan pemerintahan di tingkat kelurahan serta menjadi inspirasi bagi daerah lain.

Gawat! Jangan terlena dengan klaim ekonomi yang aman! Data BPS terbaru membongkar realitas mengejutkan di balik surplus ekonomi Indonesia 2026.

Meskipun neraca perdagangan Indonesia sepanjang Semester I 2026 (Januari–Juni) mencatat surplus sebesar 3,58 miliar dollar AS, fondasi ekonomi kita nyatanya mulai rapuh. Sinyal bahaya ini muncul setelah Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) merilis data defisit perdagangan sebesar 450 juta dollar AS pada Juni 2026. Apa penyebab utamanya?

Pembengkakan defisit sektor minyak dan gas (migas) akibat lonjakan impor energi dan tingginya kebutuhan domestik menjadi biang kerok utama yang mulai menggerus surplus perdagangan nonmigas kita.

Di video ini, kita akan membedah analisis kritis dari para ekonom terkemuka:

1. Yusuf Rendy Manilet (Ekonom CORE Indonesia): Menyoroti rapuhnya struktur ekspor Indonesia yang belum terdiversifikasi, serta tingginya ketergantungan industri nasional terhadap bahan baku impor.

2. M. Rizal Taufikurahman (Kepala Pusat Makroekonomi & Keuangan INDEF): Mengkritik keras kegagalan pemerintah dalam menekan impor migas di tengah narasi transisi energi, yang membuat ekonomi kita sangat rentan terhadap fluktuasi harga minyak dunia.

Apakah Indonesia mampu keluar dari jebakan impor energi ini, ataukah surplus perdagangan kita hanya akan menjadi cerita masa lalu? Simak analisis selengkapnya dalam video ini!

Pernah kepikiran gak sih, gimana kalau tiap kali kamu jujur sama perasaan sendiri, ada sistem ganjaran emosi yang langsung transfer uang ke rekening? Nah, itu yang dialami Wejia di alur cerita drama China ini.

Cerita ini ngambil sudut pandang Wejia, cewek yang tiba-tiba "diaktifkan" oleh sistem ganjaran emosi — semacam sistem penilaian yang ngasih hadiah uang tiap kali dia berani nunjukin perasaan asli, entah itu marah, capek, atau bahagia. Awalnya kedengeran kayak keberuntungan biasa, tapi lama-lama jadi jalan buat Wejia bangkit dari titik terendah hidupnya.

Di tengah cerita, ada drama kantor yang bikin gemes — bosnya, Tuan Liu, tipikal atasan genit yang suka seenaknya sama karyawan perempuan. Wejia gak tinggal diam, dia balas dendam dengan cara yang elegan, bukan dengan emosi meledak-ledak, tapi lewat langkah yang bikin lawan sendiri yang malu. Selain urusan kantor, ada juga benang merah asmara dan persaingan sama tokoh lain kayak Antong dan Zang Xin, yang bikin ceritanya makin berlapis — gak cuma soal duit, tapi juga soal harga diri dan kemandirian seorang wanita.

Yang bikin banyak orang penasaran, sistem ini kadang ngasih ganjaran sampai 10–20 kali lipat dari yang dikeluarin Wejia, dan itu terjadi berkali-kali sepanjang cerita — momen-momen inilah yang paling sering dicari orang pas nonton ulang alur cerita drama China jenis ini. Buat kamu yang suka nonton drama China sub Indo dengan tema wanita mandiri dan balas dendam elegan, cerita ini worth ditonton sampai habis, karena banyak quotes hidup yang related sama kehidupan sehari-hari, apalagi soal gimana caranya tetap jujur sama diri sendiri di tengah tekanan kerjaan dan keluarga.

Kalau kamu penasaran kelanjutan cerita lengkapnya di luar rekap video ini, ceritanya diadaptasi dari novel berjudul Dieu Parfait yang bisa dibaca lewat aplikasi Cucu Lecture.

Hidup ini ngajarin kita satu hal penting lewat cerita Wejia: jujur sama perasaan sendiri itu bukan kelemahan, justru kekuatan. Selama ini banyak orang mendem emosi demi keliatan "kuat" atau demi menyenangkan orang lain, padahal itu cuma bikin capek sendiri. Wejia justru dapet "ganjaran" terbesar tiap kali dia berani ngomong jujur, marah kalau memang salah, dan gak nurut sama standar yang dipaksain orang lain — entah itu dari ibunya, bosnya yang genit, atau lingkungan sekitarnya. Balas dendamnya pun elegan, bukan lewat drama murahan, tapi lewat kemandirian dan harga diri yang dia bangun sendiri. Intinya, kamu gak perlu jadi orang lain buat dihargai — jadi diri sendiri yang jujur justru yang bikin hidup kamu makin berharga. Kadang, keberanian buat jujur sama diri sendiri itu investasi terbaik yang bisa kamu kasih ke hidupmu.

Something changed in John Thune after Lindsey Graham's sudden death, and the SAVE America Act, the election integrity bill that was stalled in the Senate for a full year, is suddenly moving. In this video, we break down the phone call, the pressure campaign, and the exact words from the Senate Majority Leader that changed everything.

On the night of July 11, Senator Lindsey Graham called President Trump just hours after returning from his tenth trip to Ukraine and told him they were all set for the SAVE America Act. By https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FhKUWmMyk_4&t=623 that night, Graham was gone at age 71, with the medical examiner's preliminary finding pointing to an aortic dissection caused by cardiovascular disease. President Trump revealed the details of that final conversation on Meet the Press the next morning, calling the loss a big blow to the SAVE America Act and promising to get it done.

What happened next stunned Washington. As chairman of the Senate Budget Committee, Graham held the keys to reconciliation, the budget process that allows a bill to pass with 51 votes instead of 60. After his death, the House broke its weeks long stalemate with a 215 to 211 vote, using a maneuver known as MIRVing to attach the SAVE America Act to must pass national security funding. Anna Paulina Luna, Tim Burchett, and the conservative holdouts who froze the House floor in June finally got the commitment they demanded, and Speaker Mike Johnson promised more of the same.

Then came the moment nobody expected. John Thune, the same Majority Leader who spent a year explaining why the Byrd rule made this bill impossible, told the New York Post there is a way to pass it through reconciliation, even suggesting how to structure the bill so it survives the parliamentarian. Mike Lee is calling on the Senate to honor Graham's dying wish, pushing to cancel the August recess, and floating a return of the talking filibuster to make Democrats defend their obstruction on live television.

We also cover the historical parallel almost nobody is talking about, how a Senate death in 2010 forced Obamacare through reconciliation, and why that precedent matters now. Plus the appointment of Graham's sister, Darline Graham Nordone, to his seat, and the merciless clock ticking toward the November 3 midterms, when Graham's own seat will be on the ballot.

Garuda Tv - Kepala Badan Nasional Pencarian dan Pertolongan (Basarnas), Marsda TNI Mohammad Syafii, memastikan tidak ada korban yang tertinggal di dalam bangkai KMP Mutiara Sentosa II yang mengalami kebakaran di perairan utara Madura, Jawa Timur.

Pernyataan tersebut disampaikan berdasarkan hasil pendataan sementara yang diperoleh dari keterangan nakhoda, kru kapal, serta para penumpang yang berhasil dievakuasi. Hingga saat ini, Basarnas belum menemukan indikasi adanya korban yang masih terjebak di dalam kapal.

Meski demikian, operasi pencarian dan pertolongan (SAR) belum dihentikan. Tim SAR gabungan masih melakukan penyisiran di sekitar lokasi kejadian sambil menuntaskan proses verifikasi data manifest penumpang untuk memastikan seluruh penumpang telah terdata.

Kepala Basarnas Marsda TNI Mohammad Syafii menegaskan bahwa pencocokan data manifest dengan jumlah korban selamat maupun penumpang yang telah dievakuasi menjadi prioritas utama dalam operasi SAR. Langkah tersebut dilakukan untuk memastikan tidak ada penumpang yang belum teridentifikasi.

Selain melakukan pencarian di sekitar lokasi kebakaran, Basarnas juga berkoordinasi dengan operator kapal, otoritas pelabuhan, TNI, Polri, serta instansi terkait guna mempercepat validasi data dan memastikan seluruh penumpang dalam kondisi terdata.

Basarnas menyatakan operasi SAR akan terus berlangsung hingga seluruh proses verifikasi manifest selesai dan tidak ada lagi ketidaksesuaian data penumpang. Masyarakat diimbau menunggu informasi resmi dari pemerintah serta tidak mudah mempercayai informasi yang belum terverifikasi mengenai insiden kebakaran KMP Mutiara Sentosa II.

Dalam keterangannya, Marsda TNI Mohammad Syafii menegaskan bahwa berdasarkan informasi dari nakhoda dan kru yang selamat, tidak terdapat indikasi korban yang masih tertinggal di dalam kapal. Namun, Basarnas tetap menjalankan prosedur pencarian secara menyeluruh hingga proses verifikasi dinyatakan tuntas.

Ella Wheeler Wilcox’s Leudemann’s-on-the-River is a quietly persuasive study of human resilience and social change set against a small riverside community. Wilcox, known for her lyrical voice and emotional candor, builds a compact novel in which ordinary lives intersect with larger currents of moral awakening. The imagined town—anchored by the eponymous estate and the river that feeds its commerce and gossip—offers a stage for characters whose struggles are intimate yet emblematic: an aging steward wrestling with loss, a young woman learning the cost of freedom, a family whose fortunes ebb and flow with the seasons. Wilcox writes with a tenderness that softens judgment and a directness that cuts to the core of motive and consequence.

The narrative’s power is not in wild plot turns but in its patient observation. Wilcox sketches community rituals, economic pressures, and romantic entanglements with a poet’s attention to cadence and an essayist’s appetite for moral reflection. Themes of duty, redemption, and the capacity for individual change recur like refrains, and the river itself becomes a persistent metaphor—of time, of cleansing, and of forces beyond any single person’s control. Dialogue is naturalistic, occasionally didactic, and often threaded with the period’s earnest moralism, which modern readers may find both earnest and quaint.

Leudemann’s-on-the-River rewards readers who prize atmosphere and ethical inquiry over sensationalism. Its strengths lie in characterization, tonal consistency, and a humane worldview that refuses easy cynicism. Weaknesses include a pace that lingers where some prefer momentum and moments of melodramatic sentiment common to Victorian-era storytelling. Yet Wilcox’s voice—compassionate, lucid, and morally engaged—makes the book a modest but affecting portrait of a community’s quiet reckonings. For listeners seeking a reflective, character-driven audiobook rooted in 19th-century sensibility, Leudemann’s-on-the-River offers warmth, moral texture, and the gentle assurance that even small lives can illuminate enduring truths.

Two Republican senators who threatened to block acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's bid to lead the Justice Department said Monday that they will vote to advance his nomination, ending an impasse over plans to create a fund to compensate allies of President Donald Trump.

The statement from Republican Sen. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis came after Blanche issued an order late Sunday formally rescinding the $1.8 billion “Anti-Weaponization Fund” to compensate people who believe they were unfairly prosecuted by the Justice Department.

Cornyn and Tillis had said they would not support Blanche's nomination without written confirmation that the fund is dead.

Blanche said at a June hearing that the Justice Department would not move forward with the fund to compensate those who believe they were unfairly prosecuted, as he faced bipartisan outrage over the possibility that violent rioters who attacked police at the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021, could be considered for payments. But Cornyn and Tillis, both members of the Judiciary panel, have said they wanted to see the promise in writing before they endorsed Blanche's nomination — especially as Trump continued to express support for the idea.

In a statement late Sunday, Blanche said the order came after “good faith discussions.”

“My team and I have met with committee members and Senators over the past several weeks and addressed any concerns or outstanding questions," Blanche said.
